notes:
PhDRacket is a modern desktop IDE for Racket and the HtDP teaching languages. Programs run in the official Racket installation on your computer, and `.rkt` files stay exactly as DrRacket expects them.

**What's new:** see the [release notes](https://github.com/ouyang-matters/PhDRacket/blob/main/docs/RELEASE_NOTES.md).

## Quick install

**macOS** (Apple Silicon and Intel), in Terminal:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ouyang-matters/PhDRacket/main/install/install-macos.sh | bash
```

**Windows**, in PowerShell:

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ouyang-matters/PhDRacket/main/install/install-windows.ps1 | iex
```

The command downloads this release, checks it against the checksum published by GitHub and installs it. On macOS this avoids the *Open Anyway* step below.

## Manual install

**Windows:** download `PhDRacket_<version>_x64-setup.exe` and run it. Administrator rights are not required. If Windows SmartScreen shows a warning, choose *More info*, then *Run anyway*. The installer is not code-signed yet.

**macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel):** download `PhDRacket_<version>_universal.dmg`, open it and drag PhDRacket into Applications. The app is not notarized yet. The first time you open it, macOS blocks it; open *System Settings*, go to *Privacy & Security* and click *Open Anyway*.

## First launch

This is a **beta**. Installing and using PhDRacket requires accepting the [Beta Terms of Use](https://github.com/ouyang-matters/PhDRacket/blob/main/docs/TERMS.md); the Windows installer and the first-run Setup dialog ask you to accept them.

Setup finds your Racket installation. If Racket is not installed, click *Install Racket 9.3*: PhDRacket downloads the official installer from racket-lang.org, verifies its checksum and installs it. On Windows, the official Racket installer asks for administrator permission once.

## Updating

Installed copies check for new versions at startup and install them with one click. The check can be turned off in Settings.
